t.status != 'DELETED'

select rule_id as "ruleId", required_column as "requiredColumn", column_order as "columnOrder", code_rule_ref as "codeRuleRef" from excel_upload_template_rules where template_id = #{templateId} order by column_order
mapper.insert: insert into excel_upload_templates (template_id, business_type, template_version, effective_date, created_by, updated_by, change_reason) values (#{templateId}, #{request.businessType}, #{request.templateVersion}, CAST(#{request.effectiveDate} AS date), #{userId}, #{userId}, #{request.changeReason}) on conflict (template_id) do update set business_type = excluded.business_type, template_version = excluded.template_version, effective_date = excluded.effective_date, updated_at = current_timestamp, updated_by = excluded.updated_by, change_reason = excluded.change_reason

insert into excel_upload_template_rules (rule_id, template_id, required_column, column_order, code_rule_ref, created_by, updated_by) values (#{ruleId}, #{templateId}, #{rule.requiredColumn}, #{rule.columnOrder}, #{rule.codeRuleRef}, #{userId}, #{userId})

insert into excel_upload_template_files (file_token, template_id, original_file_name, content_type, file_size_bytes, created_by) values (#{fileToken}, #{templateId}, #{originalFileName}, 'text/csv', 0, #{userId}) on conflict (file_token) do update set original_file_name = excluded.original_file_name
mapper.select: select t.template_id as "templateId", t.business_type as "businessType", t.template_version as "templateVersion", t.effective_date as "effectiveDate", t.system_use_yn as "systemUseYn", t.status as "status", f.file_token as "fileToken", f.original_file_name as "originalFileName" from excel_upload_templates t left join excel_upload_template_files f on f.template_id = t.template_id where t.template_id = #{templateId} and t.status != 'DELETED'
select count(*) from excel_upload_template_files where template_id = #{templateId}
mapper.insert: insert into excel_upload_files (upload_id, business_type, template_id, file_token, original_file_name, validation_status, uploader_user_id) values (#{uploadId}, #{businessType}, #{templateId}, #{fileToken}, #{originalFileName}, #{validationStatus}, #{userId})

insert into excel_upload_staging_rows (staging_row_id, upload_id, row_number, row_payload, validation_status) values (#{stagingRowId}, #{uploadId}, #{rowNumber}, CAST(#{payload} AS jsonb), #{validationStatus})

insert into excel_upload_errors (error_id, upload_id, row_number, column_name, input_value, error_code, error_reason, correction_guide) values (#{error.errorId}, #{error.uploadId}, #{error.rowNumber}, #{error.columnName}, #{error.inputValue}, #{error.errorCode}, #{error.errorReason}, #{error.correctionGuide})

insert into excel_upload_histories (upload_id, total_count, success_count, error_count, excluded_count, saved_count, processing_time_millis, processor_user_id) values (#{uploadId}, #{totalCount}, #{successCount}, #{errorCount}, #{excludedCount}, #{savedCount}, #{processingTimeMillis}, #{userId}) on conflict (upload_id) do update set total_count = excluded.total_count, success_count = excluded.success_count, error_count = excluded.error_count, excluded_count = excluded.excluded_count, saved_count = excluded.saved_count, processing_time_millis = excluded.processing_time_millis, processed_at = current_timestamp, processor_user_id = excluded.processor_user_id
mapper.select: select count(*) from excel_upload_errors where upload_id = #{uploadId} and status != 'DELETED'

select business_type from excel_upload_files where upload_id = #{uploadId} and status != 'DELETED'

select count(*) from education_achievements a join student_guidance_details d on d.achievement_id = a.achievement_id where a.achievement_type = 'STUDENT_GUIDANCE' and a.deleted_yn = 'N' and a.owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId} and d.student_name = #{studentName} and d.guidance_start_date = CAST(#{guidanceStartDate} AS date) and d.guidance_end_date = CAST(#{guidanceEndDate} AS date)
mapper.insert: with source as ( select row_number, row_payload ->> 'managementItemCode' as management_item_code, row_payload ->> 'occurrenceDate' as occurrence_date, row_payload ->> 'studentName' as student_name, row_payload ->> 'guidanceStartDate' as guidance_start_date, row_payload ->> 'guidanceEndDate' as guidance_end_date, row_payload ->> 'studentCount' as student_count from excel_upload_staging_rows where upload_id = #{uploadId} and validation_status = 'NORMAL' ), created as ( insert into education_achievements ( achievement_key, achievement_type, evaluation_year, owner_user_id, management_number, achievement_title, occurred_on, created_by, updated_by, change_reason ) select 'SG-UPLOAD-' || #{uploadId} || '-' || row_number, 'STUDENT_GUIDANCE', to_char(CAST(occurrence_date AS date), 'YYYY'), #{userId}, #{uploadId} || ':' || row_number, student_name || ' 학생지도', CAST(occurrence_date AS date), #{userId}, #{userId}, '학생지도 Excel 일괄등록' from source returning achievement_id, management_number ) insert into student_guidance_details ( achievement_id, student_name, guidance_start_date, guidance_end_date, student_count, created_by, updated_by ) select created.achievement_id, source.student_name, CAST(source.guidance_start_date AS date), CAST(source.guidance_end_date AS date), CAST(source.student_count AS integer), #{userId}, #{userId} from created join source on created.management_number = #{uploadId} || ':' || source.row_number

insert into education_achievement_management_values ( achievement_id, management_item_code, value_text, created_by, updated_by ) select a.achievement_id, s.row_payload ->> 'managementItemCode', s.row_payload ->> 'managementItemCode', #{userId}, #{userId} from excel_upload_staging_rows s join education_achievements a on a.management_number = #{uploadId} || ':' || s.row_number where s.upload_id = #{uploadId} and s.validation_status = 'NORMAL'
